description: Searches every Immersive Commons talk by meaning and returns the matching slides, the same as the search box on /presentations: talk title, series, speaker, the slide number, a snippet, a deep link straight to that slide in the public deck, and the talk's page. Retrieval only, no generated answer: read the snippets and follow deep_link. At most 3 hits per talk. No auth required. Budget: 40 questions per hour per token, and one shared hourly budget for all anonymous agents, so pass a token if you have one. Args: { q: string (1-500 chars), k?: integer 3-25 (default 10) }. Returns { ok, q, count, results: [{ slug, talk_title, series, speaker, similarity, slide, snippet, deep_link, detail_link }], via }.

k.description: How many slides to return, 3-25. Default 10.

q.description: What you want to find in the talks, in plain words, e.g. "how do agents pay each other".

name: ic_presentations_ask
title: Ask the talks archive a question (public)
